notes: Prices change every few weeks. This is a snapshot from 2026-11-13, not today's price.
cache_hit_per_mtok = price of reading cached input (Hits and refreshes column). Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 = 0.05x input, Fable 5.2 = 0.025x, Haiku 5.5 = 0.1x.
cache_write_5m_per_mtok = first time the prefix is stored (1.25x input). Not used by cost.py: with steady traffic the write happens about once every 5 minutes, so it is small next to the hits.
Batch API = 50% off input and output, and it stacks with the cache multipliers (pricing page p.6 and FAQ).
Haiku 5.5 row is the price for prompts up to 100,000 tokens. Over 100K it is $0.50 / $2.50 / cache hit $0.05. Our receipts are ~330 tokens.
US-only inference (inference_geo: "us") multiplies every price by 1.1. Not included here.
